info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 - 101563789
info.description:
Secure Employee Management API. Run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner (or `npm run test:api`).
Signup creates two fresh users (User A and User B) with a unique suffix each run; their JWTs are saved to collection variables.
Note: auth endpoints are rate limited (default 10 requests / 15 min per IP, per endpoint). Wait 15 min or restart the server before re-running.

item.name: 04 - Employees (User A) - read & update
item.description: GET list, GET by id, PUT

exec: pm.test("User A sees exactly their 2 employees", () => { pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(2); j.employees.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.user).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userA_id"))); });

item.name: Get employee by id - User A own

exec: pm.test("Fields updated", () => { const e = pm.response.json().employee; pm.expect(e.position).to.eql("Senior Software Developer"); pm.expect(e.salary).to.eql(95000); });
pm.test("Error message mentions 'salary must be a positive number'", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include("salary must be a positive number"));
pm.test("Error message mentions 'Provide at least one field'", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include("Provide at least one field"));
pm.test("Error message mentions 'eid must be a valid employee ID'", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include("eid must be a valid employee ID"));
pm.test("Error message mentions 'Employee not found'", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include("Employee not found"));
pm.test("Error JSON shape", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 05 - Employees (User B)
item.description: User B creates an employee and only sees their own

item.name: Get all employees - User B (only own)

exec: pm.test("User B sees only their 1 employee, none of User A's", () => { pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(1); const ids = j.employees.map(e => e._id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empA1_id")); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empA2_id")); });
